stories.place: Carson National Forest, New Mexico, USA
stories.stat_label: years since the last one documented
stories.headline: A rare lynx was caught on camera in New Mexico
stories.summary: A PhD student checking photos from 120 trail-camera sites in Carson National Forest found a Canada lynx, the first documented in New Mexico in over 25 years. Experts confirmed it.
stories.why: Lynx are threatened in the US, and the find could shape how their snowy spruce-fir forests are managed.

stories.headline: Tiny snakes escape danger by rolling like wheels
stories.summary: Dwarf reedsnakes in Borneo cartwheel away from threats at up to 3.69 m per second, about 4 times their top slithering speed, while keeping their heads steady and facing forward.
stories.why: Animals almost never roll on purpose. These snakes manage it with no wheel-like body parts at all.

stories.stat_label: plausible moon beyond our Solar System
stories.headline: Astronomers may have found the 1st moon outside our Solar System
stories.summary: Using ESO's Very Large Telescope, a team spotted a wobble revealing a Jupiter-mass object circling a brown dwarf, which itself orbits a star in the CD-35 2722 system.
stories.why: If confirmed, it's the first known exomoon, and it's far bigger than any moon in our Solar System.

stories.headline: The world's oldest known shipwreck was found off Türkiye
stories.summary: Divers near Kekova Island found the cargo of a 10 m Bronze Age ship that sank 4,400 to 4,700 years ago: 30+ clay jars, some still holding residue, and 3 stone anchors.
stories.why: It sank around when Egypt's Great Pyramid was built: a time capsule of early Mediterranean sea trade.

fun_fact: Some jars from the 4,700-year-old shipwreck still hold a thick, glossy residue from their ancient cargo.
